<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="nl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Voor Cato ♥</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Raleway:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* ── AANPASSEN: zoek op "AANPASSEN" ── */
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --rose:    #c05038;
      --rose-lt: #e07c5c;
      --blush:   #f7ddd0;
      --text:    #2d1a0e;
      --muted:   #b08870;
      --soft:    #faeadc;
      --card:    #fffdf8;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #fff9f2 0%, #fdeee0 50%, #fff4e8 100%);
      font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
      color: var(--text);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* ── Schermen ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    .screen {
      position: fixed; inset: 0;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: .8rem 1rem;
      opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.55s ease;
      overflow-y: auto;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .screen.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

    /* ── Achtergrond hartjes ──────────────────────────── */
    #bgH { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 0; }
    .bgh {
      position: absolute; bottom: -60px; color: #f0a880; opacity: 0;
      animation: heartRise var(--dur) ease-in var(--delay) infinite;
    }

    /* ── Gedeeld ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    .screen-step { font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .screen-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 4vw, 1.9rem); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; text-align: center; }
    .div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; color: var(--blush); font-size: 0.58rem; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
    .div::before, .div::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 26px; height: 1px; background: var(--blush); }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S1 — Intro
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #s1 { text-align: center; }
    .i-sub { font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .i-name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(4.5rem, 14vw, 9rem); font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
    .i-date { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 5rem; }
    .gift-area { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.6rem; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 1rem; transform: scale(1.28); transform-origin: center top; }
    .gift-box { position: relative; width: 120px; height: 112px; animation: float 3.8s ease-in-out infinite; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(168,61,82,0.22)); transition: filter .35s; }
    .gift-area:hover .gift-box { filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 32px rgba(168,61,82,0.36)); }
    .bb { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 120px; height: 78px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#e8a0b0,#cc7088); border-radius: 3px 3px 5px 5px; }
    .bb::after { content:''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 14px; height: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.28); }
    .bl { position: absolute; top: 22px; left: -7px; width: 134px; height: 24px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#a83d52,#8e2e42); border-radius: 3px; transform-origin: 67px bottom; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .42s; z-index: 2; }
    .bl::after { content:''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 100%; height: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
    .bow { position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 54px; height: 20px; z-index: 3; }
    .bow-l,.bow-r { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 24px; height: 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-radius: 50% 50% 40% 40%; }
    .bow-l { left: 3px; transform: rotate(-22deg); transform-origin: right bottom; }
    .bow-r { right: 3px; transform: rotate(22deg); transform-origin: left bottom; }
    .bow-k { position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 10px; height: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-radius: 50%; }
    .gift-box.open .bl { transform: rotate(-55deg) translateY(-18px); opacity: 0; }
    .gift-box.open .bow { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .25s; }
    .hint { font-size: .67rem; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); animation: pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S2 — Schuifpuzzel
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #s2 {}
    .puzzle-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, var(--t,95px)); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, var(--t,95px)); gap: 3px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(168,61,82,.18); margin-bottom: .9rem; transition: box-shadow .4s; }
    .puzzle-grid.solved { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--rose-lt), 0 12px 40px rgba(168,61,82,.3); }
    .pt { width: var(--t,95px); height: var(--t,95px); cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: filter .12s; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#e8a0b0,#cc7088); background-repeat: no-repeat; }
    .pt:not(.empty):hover  { filter: brightness(1.1); }
    .pt:not(.empty):active { filter: brightness(.9); }
    .pt.empty { background: rgba(168,61,82,.07) !important; cursor: default; }
    .pt.empty::after { content:'♥'; position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.8rem; color: rgba(168,61,82,.15); }
    .tl { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size: 2rem; font-style: italic; color: #7a1a28; pointer-events: none; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.4); }
    .mc { font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
    .pw-wrap { margin-top: .9rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
    .pw-input { border: 1.5px solid var(--soft); border-radius: 50px; padding: .55rem 1.3rem; font-family: 'Raleway',sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text); background: white; outline: none; text-align: center; width: 180px; transition: border-color .2s; }
    .pw-input:focus { border-color: var(--rose-lt); }
    .pw-hint { font-size: .72rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--rose); min-height: 1em; }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S3 — Rebus + JA
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .rebus-card {
      background: #fffce8;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle at 8% 92%, rgba(210,170,20,.13) 18px, transparent 18px),
        radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%,  rgba(210,170,20,.13) 18px, transparent 18px),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(230,190,40,.05) 55px, transparent 55px);
      border: 2px solid #c8a030;
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.6rem 2.2rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 44px rgba(180,120,10,.18);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      width: min(480px,95vw);
      position: relative;
    }
    .rebus-card::before { content: '🍋'; position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: .45; }
    .rebus-card::after  { content: '🍋'; position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: .45; transform: scaleX(-1); display: block; }
    .rebus-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: .8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .r-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; min-width: 44px; }
    .r-emoji { font-size: 2.8rem; line-height: 1; }
    .r-eq { font-size: 2.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); line-height: 1; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; }
    .r-mod { font-size: .62rem; color: var(--rose); text-align: center; font-style: italic; white-space: nowrap; }
    .rq { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: .8rem; text-align: center; }
    .r-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; width: min(380px,90vw); }
    .r-input { border: 1.5px solid var(--soft); border-radius: 50px; padding: .6rem 1.4rem; font-family: 'Raleway',sans-serif; font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text); background: white; outline: none; text-align: center; width: 100%; transition: border-color .2s; }
    .r-input:focus { border-color: var(--rose-lt); }
    .r-input.wrong { border-color: #e88; animation: shake .38s ease; }
    .rfb { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--rose); min-height: 1.3em; font-style: italic; text-align: center; }

    /* JA knoppen */
    .ja-wrap { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; margin-top: 0; }
    .ja-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg,#a83d52,#c8506a);
      color: white; border: none; border-radius: 50px;
      padding: 1rem 2.8rem;
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-style: italic;
      cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: .05em;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(168,61,82,.38);
      opacity: 0; transform: translateY(90px);
      animation: flyIn .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards;
    }
    .ja-btn:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .18s; }
    .ja-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S4 — Benieuwd + Kat
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .ben-title {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem,5.5vw,2.8rem);
      font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.45;
      color: var(--rose); text-align: center; margin-bottom: 2rem; max-width: 420px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 10px rgba(192,80,56,.18));
    }
    .ben-title .qm { color: var(--rose-lt); animation: qPulse 0.7s ease-in-out infinite; display: inline-block; font-size: 1.2em; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
    .cat-area {
      position: relative;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center; gap: .8rem;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
    .poes-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
    .cat-emoji {
      width: min(260px, 72vw); aspect-ratio: 3/4; background-size: cover; background-position: center top; background-repeat: no-repeat; display: block; border-radius: 16px;
      animation: catBounce 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18));
    }
    .poes-head {
      position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 80px; height: 72px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
    .cat-hint { font-size: .67rem; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .miauw {
      position: absolute; top: 4px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style: italic;
      font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--rose);
      animation: miauwUp 2s ease-out forwards;
      pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S5 — Bootje + Onthulling
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .meer-wrap {
      width: min(480px,96vw); height: 270px;
      border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; position: relative;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(40,110,140,.28);
      margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
    }
    .meer-wrap svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
    .cloud1 { animation: cloudDrift 18s linear infinite; }
    .cloud2 { animation: cloudDrift 26s linear infinite 4s; }
    .lemon-sun { transform-origin: 370px 38px; animation: lemonGlow 3.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .sloep-g { animation: sloepVaar 20s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .sloep-inner { transform-origin: 22px 170px; animation: sloepBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .roei-l { transform-origin: 10px 165px; animation: roeiBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .roei-r { transform-origin: 34px 165px; animation: roeiBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite reverse; }
    .eend-g  { animation: eendZwem 22s linear infinite 2s; }
    .molen-blad { transform-origin: 113px 93px; animation: molenDraai 6s linear infinite; }
    .water-glans { animation: waterShimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .water-glans2 { animation: waterShimmer 4.2s ease-in-out infinite 1.4s; }

    .reveal-text {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem,6vw,3rem);
      font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; text-align: center; max-width: 500px;
    }
    .word { display: inline-block; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
    .word.revealed { animation: wordIn .55s ease forwards; }
    .word.hi { color: var(--rose); font-size: 1.12em; }
    .rfooter { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0; animation: none; }
    .egg-hint { font-family: 'Raleway',sans-serif; font-size: 0.4rem; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-top: 1rem; animation: none; }
    @keyframes eggFadeIn { to { opacity: 0.35; } }

    /* ── S6 boom ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    #s6 { text-align: center; padding: 1.2rem; }
    .boom-wrap { text-align: center; max-width: 92vw; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-end; gap: .6rem .1rem; padding: .5rem 0; }
    .boom-word { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: .04em; margin: .4rem 1.2rem; }
    .boom-letter {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 9.5vw, 6rem);
      font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2;
      color: var(--cl, var(--rose));
      animation: letterJump var(--dur,.4s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      animation-delay: var(--ld,0s);
    }
    @keyframes letterJump { from{transform:translateY(0) rotate(var(--r1,0deg)) scale(1)} to{transform:translateY(var(--ty,-18px)) rotate(var(--r2,4deg)) scale(var(--sc,1.08))} }
    .s6-lemons { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: .8rem; margin: .5rem 0; }
    .s6-lemon { font-size: 1.9rem; display: inline-block; animation: lemonDance var(--dur,.5s) ease-in-out infinite alternate; animation-delay: var(--ld,0s); }
    @keyframes lemonDance { from{transform:translateY(0) rotate(var(--rot,-15deg))} to{transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(calc(var(--rot,0deg) + 28deg))} }
    .s6-kusjes { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1.2rem; text-align: center; opacity:0; animation: fadeUp .6s ease forwards; animation-delay: .4s; }
    @keyframes flashBang { 0%{opacity:0} 18%{opacity:1} 100%{opacity:0} }

    /* ── Particles ───────────────────────────────────── */
    .sp { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; font-size: 1.3rem; animation: spBurst 1s ease forwards; }
    .hf { position: fixed; top: -20px; pointer-events: none; font-size: var(--sz); color: var(--cl); animation: hFall linear forwards; }

    /* ══ Keyframes ══════════════════════════════════════ */
    @keyframes heartRise { 0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(var(--rot));opacity:0}8%{opacity:var(--op)}92%{opacity:var(--op)}100%{transform:translateY(-115vh) rotate(calc(var(--rot)+25deg));opacity:0} }
    @keyframes fadeUp    { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
    @keyframes float     { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-9px)} }
    @keyframes pulse     { 0%,100%{opacity:.3} 50%{opacity:.85} }
    @keyframes shake     { 0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)} 20%{transform:translateX(-6px)} 40%{transform:translateX(6px)} 60%{transform:translateX(-4px)} 80%{transform:translateX(4px)} }
    @keyframes flyIn     { from{transform:translateY(90px);opacity:0} to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1} }
    @keyframes flyAway   { from{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:1} to{transform:translateY(110px) scale(.5);opacity:0} }
    @keyframes catBounce { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-11px) rotate(5deg)} }
    @keyframes catShrink { 0%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0)} 45%{transform:scale(1.35) rotate(20deg)} 100%{transform:scale(0) rotate(360deg);opacity:0} }
    @keyframes miauwUp   { 0%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)} 15%{opacity:1} 80%{opacity:1} 100%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-55px)} }
    @keyframes qPulse    { 0%,100%{opacity:.8} 50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)} }
    @keyframes cloudDrift    { from{transform:translateX(-480px)} to{transform:translateX(480px)} }
    @keyframes sloepVaar     { 0%{transform:translate(-80px,6px)} 46%{transform:translate(450px,6px)} 50%{transform:translate(450px,-6px)} 96%{transform:translate(-80px,-6px)} 100%{transform:translate(-80px,6px)} }
    @keyframes sloepBob      { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1.5deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(1.5deg)} }
    @keyframes roeiBob       { 0%,100%{transform:rotate(-28deg)} 50%{transform:rotate(28deg)} }
    @keyframes lemonGlow     { 0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,220,0,.5));transform:scale(1)} 50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,220,0,.95));transform:scale(1.08)} }
    @keyframes eendZwem      { 0%{transform:translateX(420px)} 100%{transform:translateX(-80px)} }
    @keyframes molenDraai    { from{transform:rotate(0deg)} to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }
    @keyframes waterShimmer  { 0%,100%{opacity:.18} 50%{opacity:.38} }
    @keyframes wordIn    { to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
    @keyframes hFall     { 0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);opacity:.95} 100%{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(520deg) scale(.4);opacity:0} }
    @keyframes spBurst   { 0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1.4)} 100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--tx),var(--ty)) scale(0)} }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       S4b — Woordzoeker
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #s4b { gap: .4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .wz-layout {
      display: flex; gap: .7rem; align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: center; width: min(580px,97vw);
    }
    .wz-wordlist {
      flex-shrink: 0; width: 110px; padding-top: 4px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .55rem;
      font-family: 'Raleway',sans-serif; font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .03em; color: var(--muted);
      text-align: center; align-items: center;
    }
    .wz-wordlist li { list-style: none; transition: color .25s; }
    .wz-wordlist li.found { color: var(--rose); text-decoration: line-through; }
    .wz-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(13,1fr);
      gap: 2px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 5px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(168,61,82,.15);
      flex: 1; min-width: 0; position: relative;
    }
    .wz-cell {
      aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'Raleway',sans-serif; font-size: clamp(.52rem,1.9vw,.8rem);
      font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 3px; background: var(--card); color: var(--text);
      transition: background .1s, color .1s;
      user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
    .wz-cell.sel   { background: var(--blush); color: var(--rose); }
    .wz-cell.found { background: #faeadc; color: var(--rose); font-weight: 800; }
    @keyframes wzCellShake {
      0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0deg)}
      25%{transform:translate(var(--sx,-3px),var(--sy,2px)) rotate(var(--sr,-4deg))}
      75%{transform:translate(calc(var(--sx,3px)*-1),calc(var(--sy,-2px)*-1)) rotate(calc(var(--sr,4deg)*-1))}
    }
    @keyframes wzElShake {
      0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}
      20%{transform:translate(-5px,2px)} 40%{transform:translate(5px,-3px)}
      60%{transform:translate(-4px,3px)} 80%{transform:translate(4px,-2px)}
    }
    @keyframes wzFallDown {
      0%  {opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);}
      100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(240px) rotate(var(--spin,12deg));}
    }
    @keyframes wzHeroGrow {
      0%  {transform:scale(1);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);}
      40% {transform:scale(1.5);background:var(--hero-color,var(--rose));color:#fff;border-radius:50%;}
      75% {transform:scale(2.2);opacity:1;}
      100%{transform:scale(3);opacity:0;}
    }
    .wz-quaking { animation:wzCellShake var(--sq-dur,.25s) var(--sq-delay,0s) ease-in-out infinite; }
    .wz-el-shaking { animation:wzElShake .28s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .wz-falling-item { animation:wzFallDown .85s ease-in forwards; animation-delay:var(--fd,0s); }
    .wz-hero { position:relative;z-index:10; animation:wzHeroGrow .9s ease forwards; animation-delay:var(--hd,0s); }
    .wz-success {
      position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;
      align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      pointer-events:none;z-index:50;
      opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s;
      background:rgba(255,249,242,.92);
    }
    .wz-success.show { opacity:1; }
    .wz-reveal-word { display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:baseline;gap:.02em; }
    .wz-reveal-letter {
      font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif;font-weight:900;
      font-size:clamp(2.8rem,11vw,5rem);
      display:inline-block;opacity:0;
      animation:wzLetterReveal .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards;
    }
    @keyframes wzLetterReveal {
      from{transform:scale(.1) translateY(50px) rotate(-20deg);opacity:0}
      to  {transform:scale(1)  translateY(0)    rotate(0deg);  opacity:1}
    }
    .wz-count {
      font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style: italic;
      font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--muted); text-align: center;
    }

    /* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       SRPS — Steen-Papier-Schaar
    ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #srps {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg,#fff0f5 0%,#fde8f0 50%,#fff4e8 100%);
      gap: .6rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .rps-title {
      font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-weight:600; font-style:italic;
      font-size:clamp(1.2rem,3.5vw,1.7rem);
      color:var(--text); text-align:center;
    }
    .rps-subtitle {
      font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif; font-weight:400; font-size:.6rem;
      letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); text-align:center;
    }
    .rps-ai-box {
      background:var(--card); border-radius:16px;
      padding:.8rem 1.3rem; max-width:340px; width:90%; text-align:center;
      box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(168,61,82,.10);
    }
    .rps-ai-face {
      font-size:2.8rem; display:block; line-height:1.2;
    }
    .rps-ai-face.shake { animation: rpsShake .45s ease; }
    @keyframes rpsShake {
      0%{transform:translateX(0)} 25%{transform:translateX(-6px)} 50%{transform:translateX(6px)}
      75%{transform:translateX(-4px)} 100%{transform:translateX(0)}
    }
    .rps-ai-name {
      font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:.56rem;
      letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin:.2rem 0 .5rem;
    }
    .rps-bubble {
      background:var(--soft); color:var(--text); border-radius:10px; padding:.5rem .9rem;
      font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:1rem;
      min-height:2.4rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      transition:opacity .4s; text-align:center;
    }
    .rps-score-row {
      display:flex; gap:1.2rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    }
    .rps-score-box {
      background:var(--card); border-radius:14px; padding:.5rem 1.2rem;
      text-align:center; min-width:85px;
      box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(168,61,82,.10);
    }
    .rps-score-label {
      font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:.55rem;
      letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:.1rem;
    }
    .rps-score-num {
      font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-weight:400; font-size:2.4rem; line-height:1;
      color:var(--rose);
    }
    .rps-score-num.pop { animation: rpsPop .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
    @keyframes rpsPop { 0%{transform:scale(1)} 50%{transform:scale(1.4)} 100%{transform:scale(1)} }
    .rps-vs {
      font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif; font-weight:400; font-size:.7rem;
      letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted);
    }
    .rps-btns {
      display:flex; gap:1rem; justify-content:center;
    }
    .rps-btn {
      font-size:3.8rem; width:100px; height:100px; border-radius:50%;
      background:var(--card); border:1.5px solid var(--blush); cursor:pointer;
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(168,61,82,.14);
      transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .2s;
    }
    .rps-btn:hover { transform:scale(1.12); box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(168,61,82,.22); }
    .rps-btn:active { transform:scale(.93); }
    #rpsConfetti { position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:900; }
    .rps-congrats {
      position:fixed; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      pointer-events:none; z-index:901; opacity:0; transition:opacity .5s;
    }
    .rps-congrats.show { opacity:1; }
    .rps-congrats-word {
      display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:.02em;
    }
    .rps-congrats-letter {
      font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-weight:600; font-style:italic;
      font-size:clamp(3rem,12vw,6rem);
      text-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
      display:inline-block; opacity:0;
      animation: rpsLetterIn .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) forwards;
    }
    @keyframes rpsLetterIn {
      from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(50px) scale(.4) rotate(-20deg); }
      to   { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0); }
    }
    @keyframes rpsDanceLoop {
      from { transform:rotate(-7deg) scale(1); }
      to   { transform:rotate(7deg)  scale(1.14); }
    }
    .rps-result {
      font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic;
      font-size:clamp(.95rem,3vw,1.2rem);
      text-align:center; min-height:1.6rem; color:var(--text);
      transition:opacity .3s;
    }
    .rps-choices-row {
      display:flex; gap:.6rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      font-size:1.9rem; min-height:2.6rem;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="bgH"></div>

<!-- ════════ S1: Intro ════════ -->
<div class="screen active" id="s1">
  <p class="i-sub">Voor jou, lieve</p>
  <h1 class="i-name">Cato</h1><!-- AANPASSEN: naam -->
  <div class="div">♥</div>
  <div class="gift-area" onclick="openGift()">
    <div class="gift-box" id="giftBox">
      <div class="bow"><div class="bow-l"></div><div class="bow-r"></div><div class="bow-k"></div></div>
      <div class="bl"></div><div class="bb"></div>
    </div>
    <span class="hint">Klik om te onthullen</span>
  </div>
  <p class="i-date">30/05/2026</p>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S2: Schuifpuzzel ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s2">
  <h2 class="screen-title" style="font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,5vw,2.4rem);max-width:600px;">Los de puzzel op<span onclick="goTo('s3')" style="cursor:default">!</span></h2>
  <div class="div">♥</div>
  <div class="puzzle-grid" id="pGrid"></div>
  <p class="mc" id="mc">Zetten: 0</p>
  <div class="pw-wrap">
    <input class="pw-input" id="pwInput" type="text" placeholder="" autocomplete="off" onkeydown="checkPw(event)">
    <p class="pw-hint" id="pwHint"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S3: Rebus + JA ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s3">
  <h2 class="screen-title" style="font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,5vw,2.4rem);">Ontcijfer het raadsel<span onclick="startMeow();goTo('s4')" style="cursor:default">!</span></h2>
  <div class="div">♥</div>

  <div class="rebus-card">
    <div class="rebus-row">
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-eq">=</span>
        <span class="r-mod">+M</span>
      </div>
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-emoji">🫵</span>
      </div>
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-emoji">🐈‍⬛</span>
      </div>
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-emoji">🌳</span>
        <span class="r-mod">−B, M=K</span>
      </div>
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-emoji">☀️</span>
        <span class="r-mod">−N</span>
      </div>
      <div class="r-tile">
        <span class="r-emoji">🎨</span>
        <span class="r-mod">−V, F=G, +<span onclick="startMeow();goTo('s4')" style="cursor:default">?</span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="rInputWrap" class="r-input-wrap">
    <p class="rq">Typ de zin die hier staat beschreven:</p>
    <input class="r-input" id="rInput" type="text" placeholder="" autocomplete="off" onkeydown="checkRText(event)">
    <p class="rfb" id="rfb"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="ja-wrap" id="jaWrap" style="display:none">
    <button class="ja-btn" onclick="goS4()">Ja 🥹</button>
    <button class="ja-btn" onclick="goS4()">Ja! 💕</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S4: Benieuwd + Kat ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s4">
  <p class="ben-title">
    Ben je al benieuwd<br>
    wat je cadeautje is<span class="qm">????????<span onclick="buildReveal();goTo('s5');startReveal()" style="cursor:default">?</span></span>
  </p>
  <div class="cat-area" id="catArea">
    <div class="poes-wrap">
      <div class="cat-emoji" id="catEmoji"></div>
      <div class="poes-head" onclick="clickCat()"></div>
    </div>
    <span class="cat-hint">Klik op de foto!</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S4b: Woordzoeker ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s4b">
  <h2 class="screen-title" style="font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4.5vw,2rem);">Hoh, maar je krijgt het cadeautje niet zo maar… zoek eerst deze <span onclick="wzAutoComplete()" style="cursor:default">10</span> woorden maar<span onclick="initRps();goTo('srps')" style="cursor:default;padding:0 6px;margin-left:-6px">!</span></h2>
  <div class="div">♥</div>
  <div class="wz-layout">
    <ul class="wz-wordlist" id="wzWordList">
      <li data-word="VERJAARDAG">Verjaardag</li>
      <li data-word="UTRECHT">Utrecht</li>
      <li data-word="CITROEN">Citroen</li>
      <li data-word="BOOT">Boot</li>
      <li data-word="KAT">Kat</li>
      <li data-word="MEI">Mei</li>
      <li data-word="SCRIPTIE">Scriptie</li>
      <li data-word="LIEFDE">Liefde</li>
      <li data-word="KESJE">Kesje</li>
      <li data-word="KEIZER">Keizer</li>
    </ul>
    <div id="wzGrid" class="wz-grid"></div>
  </div>
  <p id="wzCount" class="wz-count">0 van de 10 woorden gevonden</p>
</div>
<div class="wz-success" id="wzSuccess">
  <div class="wz-reveal-word" id="wzRevealWord"></div>
</div>

<!-- ════════ SRPS: Steen-Papier-Schaar ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="srps">
  <p class="rps-title">Steen, Papier of Schaar<span onclick="initPuzzle();goTo('s2')" style="cursor:default;padding:0 6px;margin-left:-6px">?</span></p>
  <p class="rps-subtitle">Best of 5 — eerste bij 3 wint<span onclick="initPuzzle();goTo('s2')" style="cursor:default">!</span></p>
  <div class="rps-ai-box">
    <span class="rps-ai-face" id="rpsAiFace">😎</span>
    <p class="rps-ai-name">— Robo-9000 —</p>
  </div>
  <div class="rps-score-row">
    <div class="rps-score-box">
      <div class="rps-score-label">jij</div>
      <div class="rps-score-num" id="rpsPlayerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="rps-vs">vs</div>
    <div class="rps-score-box">
      <div class="rps-score-label">robo</div>
      <div class="rps-score-num" id="rpsAiScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="rps-choices-row" id="rpsChoicesRow">
    <span style="font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:'Raleway',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;font-style:italic">kies hieronder</span>
  </div>
  <p class="rps-result" id="rpsResult"></p>
  <div class="rps-btns">
    <button class="rps-btn" onclick="rpsPlay('steen')" title="Steen">🪨</button>
    <button class="rps-btn" onclick="rpsPlay('papier')" title="Papier">📄</button>
    <button class="rps-btn" onclick="rpsPlay('schaar')" title="Schaar">✂️</button>
  </div>
</div>

<canvas id="rpsConfetti"></canvas>
<div class="rps-congrats" id="rpsCongrats">
  <div class="rps-congrats-word" id="rpsCongratsWord"></div>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S5: Bootje + Reveal ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s5">
  <div class="meer-wrap">
   <svg viewBox="0 0 420 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87ceeb"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d6f0f7"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="water" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4ca8c2"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a7a8c"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="brickWall" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c87941"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a85e28"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="roofGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a3e28"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3d2510"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fffbe0" stop-opacity="1"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffe066" stop-opacity="0"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id="sunRad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff7a0"/>
        <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffd700"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffb300" stop-opacity="0"/>
      </radialGradient>
      <filter id="blur2"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2"/></filter>
      <clipPath id="sceneClip"><rect width="420" height="240"/></clipPath>
    </defs>
    <g clip-path="url(#sceneClip)">

    <!-- Sky -->
    <rect width="420" height="155" fill="url(#sky)"/>

    <!-- Lemon sun with rays -->
    <!-- Sun stays, only lemon body flies out on click -->
    <g class="lemon-sun">
      <circle cx="370" cy="38" r="30" fill="url(#sunRad)" filter="url(#blur2)" opacity=".6"/>
      <line x1="370" y1="4"  x2="370" y2="14" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="395" y1="13" x2="388" y2="20" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="404" y1="38" x2="394" y2="38" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="395" y1="63" x2="388" y2="56" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="370" y1="72" x2="370" y2="62" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="345" y1="63" x2="352" y2="56" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="336" y1="38" x2="346" y2="38" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="345" y1="13" x2="352" y2="20" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g id="lemonBody" onclick="lemonClick()" style="cursor:pointer">
        <ellipse cx="370" cy="38" rx="15" ry="11" fill="#f7e020" transform="rotate(-20,370,38)"/>
        <ellipse cx="356" cy="43" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#f7e020" transform="rotate(-20,356,43)"/>
        <ellipse cx="384" cy="33" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#f7e020" transform="rotate(-20,384,33)"/>
        <ellipse cx="365" cy="34" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#fffccc" opacity=".75" transform="rotate(-20,365,34)"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Clouds -->
    <g class="cloud1" transform="translate(-320,0)">
      <ellipse cx="60" cy="30" rx="28" ry="10" fill="white" opacity=".9"/>
      <ellipse cx="74" cy="26" rx="18" ry="12" fill="white" opacity=".9"/>
      <ellipse cx="46" cy="27" rx="14" ry="9" fill="white" opacity=".9"/>
    </g>
    <g class="cloud2" transform="translate(-460,0)">
      <ellipse cx="200" cy="22" rx="22" ry="8" fill="white" opacity=".8"/>
      <ellipse cx="212" cy="18" rx="14" ry="10" fill="white" opacity=".8"/>
      <ellipse cx="190" cy="19" rx="12" ry="8" fill="white" opacity=".8"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Distant green bank far side -->
    <ellipse cx="210" cy="148" rx="220" ry="10" fill="#7ab648" opacity=".6"/>

    <!-- ── WINDMILL ── -->
    <!-- Base tower -->
    <polygon points="96,148 130,148 124,72 102,72" fill="#d9c9a8"/>
    <polygon points="96,148 130,148 124,72 102,72" fill="none" stroke="#b8a882" stroke-width=".5"/>
    <!-- Brick lines on tower -->
    <line x1="98" y1="130" x2="128" y2="130" stroke="#b8a882" stroke-width=".4"/>
    <line x1="99" y1="115" x2="127" y2="115" stroke="#b8a882" stroke-width=".4"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="100" x2="126" y2="100" stroke="#b8a882" stroke-width=".4"/>
    <line x1="101" y1="85" x2="125" y2="85" stroke="#b8a882" stroke-width=".4"/>
    <!-- Cap/roof of mill -->
    <ellipse cx="113" cy="72" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#5a3e28"/>
    <polygon points="99,74 127,74 120,60 106,60" fill="#6b4c2a"/>
    <!-- Door -->
    <rect x="107" y="133" width="12" height="15" rx="6" ry="0" fill="#5a3e28"/>
    <rect x="107" y="140" width="12" height="8" fill="#3d2510"/>
    <!-- Window on tower -->
    <rect x="108" y="108" width="10" height="9" rx="2" fill="#a8d4e8"/>
    <line x1="113" y1="108" x2="113" y2="117" stroke="#6699aa" stroke-width=".7"/>
    <line x1="108" y1="112" x2="118" y2="112" stroke="#6699aa" stroke-width=".7"/>

    <!-- Mill blades (4 arms rotating around hub) -->
    <g class="molen-blad">
      <!-- arm 1 up -->
      <line x1="113" y1="93" x2="113" y2="56" stroke="#7a5c30" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <polygon points="110,56 116,56 118,68 108,68" fill="#c8a870" opacity=".9"/>
      <!-- arm 2 right -->
      <line x1="113" y1="93" x2="150" y2="93" stroke="#7a5c30" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <polygon points="150,90 150,96 138,98 138,88" fill="#c8a870" opacity=".9"/>
      <!-- arm 3 down -->
      <line x1="113" y1="93" x2="113" y2="130" stroke="#7a5c30" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <polygon points="110,130 116,130 118,118 108,118" fill="#c8a870" opacity=".9"/>
      <!-- arm 4 left -->
      <line x1="113" y1="93" x2="76" y2="93" stroke="#7a5c30" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <polygon points="76,90 76,96 88,98 88,88" fill="#c8a870" opacity=".9"/>
      <!-- hub -->
      <circle cx="113" cy="93" r="4" fill="#5a3e28"/>
      <circle cx="113" cy="93" r="2" fill="#8a6a40"/>

    </g>

    <!-- Water surface -->
    <rect x="0" y="148" width="420" height="92" fill="url(#water)"/>

    <!-- Water reflections / shimmer -->
    <rect class="water-glans"  x="30"  y="155" width="60" height="2" rx="1" fill="white" opacity=".18"/>
    <rect class="water-glans2" x="160" y="162" width="80" height="2" rx="1" fill="white" opacity=".18"/>
    <rect class="water-glans"  x="300" y="158" width="50" height="2" rx="1" fill="white" opacity=".18"/>
    <rect class="water-glans2" x="80"  y="172" width="40" height="1" rx="1" fill="white" opacity=".12"/>
    <rect class="water-glans"  x="240" y="175" width="70" height="1" rx="1" fill="white" opacity=".12"/>

    <!-- Mill reflection in water (subtle) -->
    <polygon points="96,148 130,148 124,165 102,165" fill="#c8a870" opacity=".12"/>

    <!-- Near bank / reeds -->
    <ellipse cx="210" cy="148" rx="220" ry="7" fill="#6a9940"/>
    <!-- Reed stems left -->
    <line x1="18" y1="148" x2="16" y2="126" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="16" cy="124" rx="2" ry="5" fill="#7a5a10"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="148" x2="28" y2="128" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="28" cy="126" rx="2" ry="5" fill="#7a5a10"/>
    <line x1="12" y1="148" x2="10" y2="132" stroke="#4a6a20" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="130" rx="1.5" ry="4" fill="#8a6a18"/>
    <!-- Reed stems right -->
    <line x1="396" y1="148" x2="398" y2="128" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="398" cy="126" rx="2" ry="5" fill="#7a5a10"/>
    <line x1="404" y1="148" x2="406" y2="132" stroke="#5a7a2a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="406" cy="130" rx="1.5" ry="4" fill="#8a6a18"/>

    <!-- ── SLOEP sailing left ── -->
    <g class="sloep-g">
      <g class="sloep-inner">
        <!-- wake / water displacement -->
        <ellipse cx="22" cy="177" rx="24" ry="3" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.12)"/>
        <path d="M-10,177 Q5,174 18,177" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.1" opacity=".45"/>
        <path d="M26,177 Q39,174 52,177" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.1" opacity=".45"/>
        <!-- hull outer -->
        <path d="M1,0 Q22,-6 43,0 L39,13 Q22,18 5,13 Z" fill="#7a4e2c" transform="translate(0,162)"/>
        <!-- hull stripe -->
        <path d="M4,174 Q22,170 40,174" fill="none" stroke="#c8905a" stroke-width="1.3"/>
        <!-- inside -->
        <path d="M6,163 Q22,160 38,163 L36,172 Q22,175 8,172 Z" fill="#a87048"/>
        <!-- seat planks -->
        <rect x="9" y="164" width="26" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#c8905a"/>
        <rect x="10" y="169" width="24" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#c8905a"/>
        <!-- person body -->
        <rect x="16" y="156" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#5577aa"/>
        <!-- person head -->
        <circle cx="21" cy="154" r="4.5" fill="#f0c88a"/>
        <!-- straw hat -->
        <ellipse cx="21" cy="150" rx="6" ry="1.8" fill="#d4a040"/>
        <rect x="18" y="148" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#e8b850"/>
        <!-- oar left (animated) -->
        <g class="roei-l">
          <line x1="10" y1="165" x2="-5" y2="176" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
          <ellipse cx="-6" cy="177" rx="4.5" ry="1.5" fill="#6b3e1c"/>
        </g>
        <!-- oar right (animated) -->
        <g class="roei-r">
          <line x1="34" y1="165" x2="49" y2="176" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
          <ellipse cx="50" cy="177" rx="4.5" ry="1.5" fill="#6b3e1c"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- ── DUCK ── -->
    <g class="eend-g">
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="195" rx="7" ry="4" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="15" cy="193" r="3.5" fill="#3a6e2a"/>
      <path d="M17,193 L21,194 L17,195" fill="#e8a020"/>
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="196" rx="7" ry="1.5" fill="white" opacity=".3"/>
    </g>

    </g>
   </svg>
  </div>
  <div class="reveal-text" id="rText"></div>
  <p class="rfooter" id="rFoot"></p>
  <p class="egg-hint">Kijk nog eens goed naar het filmpje, zie je wat geks?</p>
</div>

<!-- ════════ S6: Boom! ════════ -->
<div class="screen" id="s6">
  <div class="s6-lemons">
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.52s;--ld:0s;--rot:-18deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.38s;--ld:.08s;--rot:12deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.61s;--ld:.14s;--rot:-5deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.44s;--ld:.05s;--rot:20deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.57s;--ld:.19s;--rot:-14deg">🍋</span>
  </div>
  <div class="boom-wrap" id="boomWrap"></div>
  <div class="s6-lemons">
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.46s;--ld:.1s;--rot:16deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.59s;--ld:0s;--rot:-10deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.35s;--ld:.22s;--rot:8deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.53s;--ld:.07s;--rot:-20deg">🍋</span>
    <span class="s6-lemon" style="--dur:.41s;--ld:.16s;--rot:5deg">🍋</span>
  </div>
  <p class="s6-kusjes">
    Kusjes van je nerderige vriendje die dit voor je gemaakt heeft ♥<br><br>
    Fijne verjaardag gewenst en op naar nog veel meer moois!!<br><br>
    xx Bas
  </p>
</div>

<script>
  /* AANPASSEN: sla de foto op als 'puzzel-foto.jpg' in dezelfde map */
  const IMG = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';
    /* Achtergrond hartjes */
  const bg = document.getElementById('bgH');
  ['♥','♡','❤','✿','✦'].forEach(ic => {
    for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
      const h = Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), {className:'bgh', textContent:ic});
      h.style.cssText = `left:${Math.random()*100}vw;font-size:${.5+Math.random()*1.2}rem;--op:${.04+Math.random()*.1};--dur:${9+Math.random()*13}s;--delay:${Math.random()*14}s;--rot:${-18+Math.random()*36}deg;`;
      bg.appendChild(h);
    }
  });

  function goTo(id) {
    document.querySelector('.screen.active').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  }

  /* ── S1: Cadeaudoos ──────────────────────────────── */
  let s1done = false;
  function openGift() {
    if (s1done) return; s1done = true;
    const box = document.getElementById('giftBox');
    box.style.animation = 'none'; void box.offsetWidth;
    box.style.animation = 'shake .48s ease';
    setTimeout(() => {
      box.classList.add('open'); spawnSp(box);
      setTimeout(() => { buildWordSearch(); goTo('s4b'); }, 520);
    }, 480);
  }

  /* ── S2: Schuifpuzzel ────────────────────────────── */
  const N = 3;
  const T = Math.min(115, Math.floor((Math.min(window.innerWidth * .93, 440) - 6) / 3));
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--t', T + 'px');
  let state = [], moves = 0;

  function initPuzzle() {
    state = Array.from({length:N*N},(_,i)=>i);
    let e = N*N-1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
      const nb = nb2(e), p = nb[Math.floor(Math.random()*nb.length)];
      [state[e],state[p]]=[state[p],state[e]]; e=p;
    }
    moves=0; renderP();
  }
  function nb2(pos) {
    const r=Math.floor(pos/N),c=pos%N,o=[];
    if(r>0)o.push(pos-N);if(r<N-1)o.push(pos+N);
    if(c>0)o.push(pos-1);if(c<N-1)o.push(pos+1);
    return o;
  }
  function renderP() {
    const g = document.getElementById('pGrid'); g.innerHTML='';
    state.forEach((tid,gp) => {
      const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className='pt';
      if (tid===N*N-1) { el.classList.add('empty'); } else {
        const r=Math.floor(tid/N),c=tid%N;
        el.style.backgroundImage=`url('${IMG}'),linear-gradient(135deg,#e8a0b0,#cc7088)`;
        el.style.backgroundSize=`${N*T}px ${N*T}px,cover`;
        el.style.backgroundPosition=`-${c*T}px -${r*T}px,center`;
        el.style.backgroundRepeat='no-repeat,no-repeat';
      }
      el.addEventListener('click',()=>clickP(gp));
      g.appendChild(el);
    });
    document.getElementById('mc').textContent=`Zetten: ${moves}`;
  }
  function clickP(gp) {
    const e=state.indexOf(N*N-1);
    if(!nb2(e).includes(gp))return;
    [state[gp],state[e]]=[state[e],state[gp]]; moves++; renderP();
    if(state.every((v,i)=>v===i)){
      document.getElementById('pGrid').classList.add('solved');
      spawnH(30);
      setTimeout(()=>goTo('s3'),900);
    }
  }

  function checkPw(e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    const val = document.getElementById('pwInput').value.trim();
    const hint = document.getElementById('pwHint');
    if (val.toLowerCase() === 'ik ben een loser') {
      hint.textContent = '✓ Juist!';
      setTimeout(() => goTo('s3'), 600);
    } else {
      hint.textContent = 'Helaas, probeer het nog eens...';
      document.getElementById('pwInput').value = '';
    }
  }

  /* ── S3: Rebus ───────────────────────────────────── */
  let wc=0, rdone=false;
  function checkRText(e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    if (rdone) return;
    const inp = document.getElementById('rInput');
    const val = inp.value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[?!.]+$/, '');
    if (val === 'mis jij poekie ook zo erg') {
      rdone = true;
      document.getElementById('rfb').textContent = 'Ja! Precies! 💔';
      inp.disabled = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('rInputWrap').style.display = 'none';
        const jw = document.getElementById('jaWrap');
        jw.style.display = 'flex';
        void jw.offsetWidth;
      }, 800);
    } else {
      wc++;
      inp.classList.add('wrong');
      document.getElementById('rfb').textContent = wc >= 2
        ? 'Tip: begin met "Mis jij…" 🐱' : 'Hmm, niet helemaal — probeer het nog eens!';
      setTimeout(() => { inp.classList.remove('wrong'); inp.value = ''; }, 600);
    }
  }

  let jaDone=false;
  function goS4() {
    if(jaDone)return; jaDone=true;
    document.querySelectorAll('.ja-btn').forEach((b,i)=>{
      b.style.animation=`flyAway .38s ease-in ${i*.09}s forwards`;
    });
    setTimeout(()=>{ startMeow(); goTo('s4'); }, 520);
  }

  /* ── S4: Kat ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const CAT_IMG='data:image/jpeg;base64,';
  document.getElementById('catEmoji').style.backgroundImage='url('+CAT_IMG+')';
  let meowIv, catReady=false;
  function startMeow() {
    catReady=true;
    const phrases=['Miauw!','Purrr...','Miauw?','...miauw','Miiiauw!'];
    const area=document.getElementById('catArea');
    meowIv=setInterval(()=>{
      const b=document.createElement('div'); b.className='miauw';
      b.textContent=phrases[Math.floor(Math.random()*phrases.length)];
      b.style.left=`calc(50% + ${(Math.random()-.5)*64}px)`;
      area.appendChild(b);
      setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),2200);
    },1400);
  }
  function clickCat() {
    if(!catReady)return; catReady=false;
    clearInterval(meowIv);
    const cat=document.getElementById('catEmoji');
    cat.style.animation='catShrink .65s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(()=>{ buildReveal(); goTo('s5'); startReveal(); },540);
  }

  /* ── S5: Bootje + Onthulling ─────────────────────── */
  /* AANPASSEN: de onthullingstekst per regel */
  const lines = [
    ['Wij','gaan','deze','zomer'],
    ['lekker','samen'],
    ['een','hele','dag','bootje','varen'],
    ['in','de','buurt','van','Grou!'],
  ];
  const hiW = new Set(['Grou!','samen','zomer','varen']);

  /* ── Woordzoeker ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const WZ_WORDS = ['VERJAARDAG','UTRECHT','CITROEN','BOOT','KAT','MEI','SCRIPTIE','LIEFDE','KESJE','KEIZER'];
  const WZ_PLACE = [
    {w:'VERJAARDAG', r:1,  c:0,  dr:0,  dc:1 },  // →
    {w:'UTRECHT',    r:0,  c:12, dr:1,  dc:0 },  // ↓
    {w:'CITROEN',    r:3,  c:2,  dr:1,  dc:1 },  // ↘
    {w:'BOOT',       r:0,  c:9,  dr:0,  dc:-1},  // ← (backwards)
    {w:'KAT',        r:12, c:0,  dr:-1, dc:1 },  // ↗
    {w:'MEI',        r:5,  c:9,  dr:1,  dc:1 },  // ↘
    {w:'SCRIPTIE',   r:11, c:2,  dr:0,  dc:1 },  // →
    {w:'LIEFDE',     r:5,  c:0,  dr:1,  dc:1 },  // ↘
    {w:'KESJE',      r:7,  c:0,  dr:1,  dc:0 },  // ↓
    {w:'KEIZER',     r:12, c:12, dr:-1, dc:-1},  // ↖ (backwards diagonal)
  ];
  // Hero cells that spell GOED GEDAAN (row,col → 0-based in 13×13 grid)
  const WZ_GOED = [
    {r:1,c:9, color:'#c05038'}, // G  (VERJAARDAG)
    {r:7,c:6, color:'#d4852a'}, // O  (CITROEN)
    {r:8,c:7, color:'#6a9e38'}, // E  (CITROEN)
    {r:1,c:7, color:'#3a7ab0'}, // D  (VERJAARDAG)
    null,                        // space
    {r:3,c:9, color:'#9a40b0'}, // G  (forced filler)
    {r:7,c:2, color:'#e07c5c'}, // E  (LIEFDE)
    {r:9,c:4, color:'#c85070'}, // D  (LIEFDE)
    {r:1,c:4, color:'#3d8a6e'}, // A  (VERJAARDAG)
    {r:1,c:5, color:'#c05038'}, // A  (VERJAARDAG)
    {r:9,c:8, color:'#d4852a'}, // N  (CITROEN)
  ];
  let wzSel = [], wzFound = new Set();

  function buildWordSearch() {
    const N = 13;
    const g = Array.from({length:N}, () => Array(N).fill(''));
    WZ_PLACE.forEach(({w,r,c,dr,dc}) => {
      [...w].forEach((ch,i) => { g[r+dr*i][c+dc*i] = ch; });
    });
    const al = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    for (let r=0;r<N;r++) for (let c=0;c<N;c++)
      if (!g[r][c]) g[r][c] = al[Math.floor(Math.random()*26)];
    g[3][9] = 'G'; // reserved for Goed gedaan celebration

    const el = document.getElementById('wzGrid');
    el.innerHTML = '';
    // SVG overlay for found-word lines
    const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
    svg.id = 'wzSvg';
    svg.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;';
    el.appendChild(svg);

    for (let r=0;r<N;r++) for (let c=0;c<N;c++) {
      const cell = document.createElement('div');
      cell.className = 'wz-cell';
      cell.textContent = g[r][c];
      cell.dataset.r = r; cell.dataset.c = c;
      cell.addEventListener('click', () => wzClick(r, c, g));
      el.appendChild(cell);
    }
    wzSel = []; wzFound = new Set();
    document.getElementById('wzCount').textContent = '0 van de 10 woorden gevonden';
  }

  function wzClick(row, col, grid) {
    const getEl = (r,c) => document.querySelector(`#wzGrid .wz-cell[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`);
    if (wzSel.length === 0) {
      wzSel = [{r:row,c:col}];
      getEl(row,col).classList.add('sel');
      return;
    }
    const last = wzSel[wzSel.length-1];
    if (last.r===row && last.c===col) { wzClearSel(); return; }
    const dr = row-last.r, dc = col-last.c;
    if (wzSel.length === 1) {
      if (Math.abs(dr)<=1 && Math.abs(dc)<=1) {
        wzSel.push({r:row,c:col}); getEl(row,col).classList.add('sel');
      } else {
        wzClearSel(); wzSel=[{r:row,c:col}]; getEl(row,col).classList.add('sel');
      }
    } else {
      const xdr=wzSel[1].r-wzSel[0].r, xdc=wzSel[1].c-wzSel[0].c;
      if (dr===xdr && dc===xdc) {
        wzSel.push({r:row,c:col}); getEl(row,col).classList.add('sel');
      } else {
        wzClearSel(); wzSel=[{r:row,c:col}]; getEl(row,col).classList.add('sel');
      }
    }
    const txt = wzSel.map(({r,c})=>grid[r][c]).join('');
    if (WZ_WORDS.includes(txt)) { wzMarkFound(txt, [...wzSel]); wzClearSel(); }
  }

  function wzClearSel() {
    wzSel.forEach(({r,c}) => {
      const el = document.querySelector(`#wzGrid .wz-cell[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`);
      if (el && !el.classList.contains('found')) el.classList.remove('sel');
    });
    wzSel = [];
  }

  function wzMarkFound(word, cells) {
    const lineColors = ['#c05038','#3a7ab0','#6a9e38','#d4a030','#9a40b0','#e07c5c','#c85070','#3a7ab0'];
    cells.forEach(({r,c}) => {
      const el = document.querySelector(`#wzGrid .wz-cell[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`);
      if (el) { el.classList.remove('sel'); el.classList.add('found'); }
    });
    wzFound.add(word);
    const li = document.querySelector(`#wzWordList li[data-word="${word}"]`);
    if (li) li.classList.add('found');
    // Draw line through found word
    const gridEl = document.getElementById('wzGrid');
    const gRect  = gridEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const c1 = document.querySelector(`#wzGrid .wz-cell[data-r="${cells[0].r}"][data-c="${cells[0].c}"]`);
    const c2 = document.querySelector(`#wzGrid .wz-cell[data-r="${cells[cells.length-1].r}"][data-c="${cells[cells.length-1].c}"]`);
    const r1 = c1.getBoundingClientRect(), r2 = c2.getBoundingClientRect();
    const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    line.setAttribute('x1', r1.left-gRect.left+r1.width/2);
    line.setAttribute('y1', r1.top -gRect.top +r1.height/2);
    line.setAttribute('x2', r2.left-gRect.left+r2.width/2);
    line.setAttribute('y2', r2.top -gRect.top +r2.height/2);
    line.setAttribute('stroke', lineColors[(wzFound.size-1)%lineColors.length]);
    line.setAttribute('stroke-width','3.5');
    line.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');
    line.setAttribute('opacity','0.7');
    document.getElementById('wzSvg').appendChild(line);
    const n = wzFound.size;
    document.getElementById('wzCount').textContent = `${n} van de 10 woorden gevonden`;
    if (n >= 10) setTimeout(()=>wzCelebrate(), 600);
  }

  /* ── SRPS: Steen-Papier-Schaar ─────────────────── */
  let rpsRound = 0, rpsBusy = false;
  const rpsEmoji = { steen:'🪨', papier:'📄', schaar:'✂️' };
  // Script: rounds 0,1 → AI wins. Rounds 2,3,4 → Player wins.
  const rpsScript = [
    { aiWins:true,  face:'😌', bubble:'Precies zoals berekend.' },
    { aiWins:true,  face:'😌', bubble:'Volledig voorspelbaar. Goed geprobeerd.' },
    { aiWins:false, face:'🤨', bubble:'...dat had ik niet verwacht.' },
    { aiWins:false, face:'😟', bubble:'Dit is statistisch onwaarschijnlijk.' },
    { aiWins:false, face:'😶', bubble:'Fine. Goed gedaan. Echt. (Leugen.)' },
  ];

  function rpsFireConfetti() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('rpsConfetti');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    const colors = ['#c05038','#e07c5c','#f7ddd0','#f7c948','#a0d8a0','#b0d0f0','#f0b0c8'];
    const pieces = Array.from({length:180}, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
      y: Math.random() * -canvas.height * .5,
      w: 8 + Math.random() * 9,
      h: 4 + Math.random() * 5,
      color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
      speed: 2.5 + Math.random() * 3,
      angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      spin: (Math.random() - .5) * .18,
      drift: (Math.random() - .5) * 1.4,
    }));
    let animId;
    function draw() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      pieces.forEach(p => {
        p.y += p.speed; p.x += p.drift; p.angle += p.spin;
        if (p.y > canvas.height) { p.y = -20; p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; }
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.rotate(p.angle);
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.fillRect(-p.w/2, -p.h/2, p.w, p.h);
        ctx.restore();
      });
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    draw();
    return () => { cancelAnimationFrame(animId); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); };
  }

  function initRps() {
    rpsRound = 0; rpsBusy = false;
    document.getElementById('rpsPlayerScore').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('rpsAiScore').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('rpsAiFace').textContent = '😎';
    document.getElementById('rpsResult').textContent = '';
    document.getElementById('rpsChoicesRow').innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:\'Raleway\',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;font-style:italic">kies hieronder</span>';
  }

  function rpsPlay(playerChoice) {
    if (rpsBusy || rpsRound >= 5) return;
    rpsBusy = true;
    const script = rpsScript[rpsRound];
    const beatsPlayer  = { steen:'papier',  papier:'schaar', schaar:'steen'  };
    const losesToPlayer = { steen:'schaar', papier:'steen',  schaar:'papier' };
    const aiChoice = script.aiWins ? beatsPlayer[playerChoice] : losesToPlayer[playerChoice];

    const faceEl   = document.getElementById('rpsAiFace');
    const vsStyle  = 'font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);font-family:\'Raleway\',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em';

    document.getElementById('rpsResult').textContent = '';
    document.getElementById('rpsChoicesRow').innerHTML = `${rpsEmoji[playerChoice]} <span style="${vsStyle}">vs</span> 🤔`;
    faceEl.textContent = '🤔';

    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('rpsChoicesRow').innerHTML =
        `${rpsEmoji[playerChoice]} <span style="${vsStyle}">vs</span> ${rpsEmoji[aiChoice]}`;

      faceEl.textContent = script.face;

      let resultText;
      if (script.aiWins) {
        const as = document.getElementById('rpsAiScore');
        as.textContent = parseInt(as.textContent) + 1;
        as.classList.remove('pop'); void as.offsetWidth; as.classList.add('pop');
        resultText = 'robo wint deze ronde.';
      } else {
        faceEl.classList.add('shake');
        setTimeout(() => faceEl.classList.remove('shake'), 460);
        const ps = document.getElementById('rpsPlayerScore');
        ps.textContent = parseInt(ps.textContent) + 1;
        ps.classList.remove('pop'); void ps.offsetWidth; ps.classList.add('pop');
        resultText = 'jij wint deze ronde.';
      }
      document.getElementById('rpsResult').textContent = resultText;
      rpsRound++;

      if (rpsRound >= 5) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          faceEl.textContent = '😭';
          document.getElementById('rpsResult').textContent = 'Ultieme comeback. ♥';
          const stopConfetti = rpsFireConfetti();
          const congrats = document.getElementById('rpsCongrats');
          const letterColors = ['#c05038','#d4852a','#6a9e38','#3a7ab0','#9a40b0','#e07c5c','#c85070','#3d8a6e'];
          const word = document.getElementById('rpsCongratsWord');
          word.innerHTML = '';
          [...'Gefeliciteerd!!'].forEach((ch, i) => {
            const s = document.createElement('span');
            s.className = 'rps-congrats-letter';
            s.textContent = ch;
            s.style.color = letterColors[i % letterColors.length];
            s.style.animationDelay = `${i * 90}ms`;
            word.appendChild(s);
          });
          congrats.classList.add('show');
          setTimeout(() => {
            word.querySelectorAll('.rps-congrats-letter').forEach((el, i) => {
              el.style.opacity = '1';
              el.style.animation = `rpsDanceLoop ${0.42 + (i % 4) * 0.07}s ${i * 25}ms ease-in-out infinite alternate`;
            });
          }, 1600);
          setTimeout(() => {
            stopConfetti();
            congrats.classList.remove('show');
            initPuzzle(); goTo('s2');
          }, 5800);
        }, 800);
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => { rpsBusy = false; }, 950);
      }
    }, 2200);
  }

  function wzFireConfetti() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:40;';
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    const colors = ['#c05038','#e07c5c','#f7c948','#6a9e38','#3a7ab0','#9a40b0','#c85070','#f0b0c8'];
    const pieces = Array.from({length:150}, ()=>({
      x:Math.random()*canvas.width, y:Math.random()*-canvas.height*.5,
      w:8+Math.random()*9, h:4+Math.random()*5,
      color:colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)],
      speed:2.5+Math.random()*3, angle:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
      spin:(Math.random()-.5)*.18, drift:(Math.random()-.5)*1.4,
    }));
    let animId;
    function draw() {
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
      pieces.forEach(p=>{
        p.y+=p.speed; p.x+=p.drift; p.angle+=p.spin;
        if(p.y>canvas.height){p.y=-20;p.x=Math.random()*canvas.width;}
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(p.angle);
        ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.fillRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h);
        ctx.restore();
      });
      animId=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    draw();
    setTimeout(()=>{ cancelAnimationFrame(animId); canvas.remove(); }, 5500);
  }

  function wzAutoComplete() {
    WZ_PLACE.forEach(place => {
      if (wzFound.has(place.w)) return;
      const cells = [];
      for (let i=0; i<place.w.length; i++)
        cells.push({r: place.r+place.dr*i, c: place.c+place.dc*i});
      wzMarkFound(place.w, cells);
    });
  }

  function wzCelebrate() {
    const screen = document.getElementById('s4b');
    const allCells = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.wz-cell'));
    const N = 13;
    const heroSet = new Set(WZ_GOED.filter(Boolean).map(({r,c})=>r*N+c));

    // 1. Shake all cells individually + other elements (2 seconds)
    allCells.forEach(el => {
      el.style.setProperty('--sx', `${(Math.random()-.5)*6}px`);
      el.style.setProperty('--sy', `${(Math.random()-.5)*4}px`);
      el.style.setProperty('--sr', `${(Math.random()-.5)*8}deg`);
      el.style.setProperty('--sq-dur', `${0.18+Math.random()*.18}s`);
      el.style.setProperty('--sq-delay', `${Math.random()*.06}s`);
      el.classList.add('wz-quaking');
    });
    const shakeEls = [screen.querySelector('h2'), screen.querySelector('.div'),
      document.getElementById('wzWordList'), document.getElementById('wzCount')];
    shakeEls.forEach(el => { if(el) el.classList.add('wz-el-shaking'); });

    setTimeout(()=>{
      // 2. Stop shaking
      allCells.forEach(el => el.classList.remove('wz-quaking'));
      shakeEls.forEach(el => { if(el) el.classList.remove('wz-el-shaking'); });

      // Fall non-hero cells
      allCells.forEach((el,i) => {
        if(heroSet.has(i)) return;
        el.style.setProperty('--spin',`${(Math.random()-.5)*80}deg`);
        el.style.setProperty('--fd',`${Math.random()*.55}s`);
        el.classList.add('wz-falling-item');
      });
      // Fall other elements + SVG lines
      [...shakeEls, document.getElementById('wzSvg')].forEach((el,i) => {
        if(!el) return;
        el.style.setProperty('--spin',`${(Math.random()-.5)*14}deg`);
        el.style.setProperty('--fd',`${i*.06}s`);
        el.classList.add('wz-falling-item');
      });

      // Hero cells grow and flash their color
      WZ_GOED.forEach((cell,i) => {
        if(!cell) return;
        const el = allCells[cell.r*N+cell.c];
        if(!el) return;
        el.style.setProperty('--hero-color', cell.color);
        el.style.setProperty('--hd', `${i*.07}s`);
        el.classList.add('wz-hero');
      });

      // 3. After animations, show "Goed gedaan!" + confetti
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const word = document.getElementById('wzRevealWord');
        word.innerHTML = '';
        const display = ['G','o','e','d',' ','g','e','d','a','a','n','!'];
        const colorList = WZ_GOED.filter(Boolean).map(c=>c.color);
        colorList.push('#9a40b0'); // for !
        let ci = 0;
        display.forEach((ch,i) => {
          if(ch===' '){
            const sp=document.createElement('span');
            sp.style.cssText='display:inline-block;width:.7em';
            word.appendChild(sp); return;
          }
          const s=document.createElement('span');
          s.className='wz-reveal-letter';
          s.textContent=ch;
          s.style.color=colorList[ci++]||'#c05038';
          s.style.animationDelay=`${i*.1}s`;
          word.appendChild(s);
        });
        document.getElementById('wzSuccess').classList.add('show');
        wzFireConfetti();
        setTimeout(()=>{
          document.getElementById('wzSuccess').classList.remove('show');
          initRps(); goTo('srps');
        }, 6000);
      }, 1100);
    }, 2000);
  }

  function buildReveal() {
    const c=document.getElementById('rText'); c.innerHTML='';
    lines.forEach(ln=>{
      const row=document.createElement('div');
      ln.forEach(w=>{
        const s=document.createElement('span');
        s.className='word'+(hiW.has(w)?' hi':'');
        s.textContent=w+'\u00A0';
        row.appendChild(s);
      });
      c.appendChild(row);
    });
    const foot=document.getElementById('rFoot');
    foot.style.animation='none'; foot.style.opacity='0';
    const egg=document.querySelector('.egg-hint');
    if(egg){ egg.style.animation='none'; egg.style.opacity='0'; }
  }

  function startReveal() {
    const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#rText div'));
    let ms=5000;
    rows.forEach((row,ri)=>{
      const words=Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('.word'));
      words.forEach((el,wi)=>{
        const isLast=ri===rows.length-1 && wi===words.length-1;
        if(isLast) ms+=2000; // extra suspense before Grou!
        setTimeout(()=>{ el.classList.add('revealed'); }, ms);
        ms+=500; // 0.5s between words on same line
      });
      ms+=1000; // extra 1.5s total between lines (0.5 already added for last word)
    });
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const foot=document.getElementById('rFoot');
      foot.style.animation='fadeUp .6s ease forwards';
      const egg=document.querySelector('.egg-hint');
      if(egg) egg.style.animation='eggFadeIn .6s ease forwards';
    }, ms+600);
    setTimeout(()=>{ spawnH(120); setTimeout(()=>spawnH(70),950); }, ms+800);
  }

  /* ── Particles ───────────────────────────────────── */
  function spawnSp(box) {
    const icons=['♥','💕','✨','🌸','❤'];
    const r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx=r.left+r.width/2, cy=r.top+r.height/2;
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
      const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='sp';
      el.textContent=icons[Math.floor(Math.random()*icons.length)];
      const a=(i/8)*2*Math.PI, d=70+Math.random()*55;
      el.style.cssText=`left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px;color:#e8a0b0;animation-delay:${i*.055}s;--tx:${Math.cos(a)*d}px;--ty:${Math.sin(a)*d}px;`;
      document.body.appendChild(el); setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),1600);
    }
  }
  function spawnH(n) {
    const ic=['♥','♡','❤','🌸','🛶','💕','✿','☀️','🐾'];
    const cl=['#f0a880','#e07c5c','#f7ddd0','#c05038','#ffd6c0','#d4906a'];
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='hf';
      el.textContent=ic[Math.floor(Math.random()*ic.length)];
      el.style.cssText=`left:${Math.random()*100}vw;--sz:${.75+Math.random()*1.3}rem;--cl:${cl[Math.floor(Math.random()*cl.length)]};animation-duration:${1.6+Math.random()*2.4}s;animation-delay:${Math.random()*.9}s;`;
      document.body.appendChild(el); setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),5500);
    }
  }

  /* ── Lemon bomb ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function lemonClick() {
    const body = document.getElementById('lemonBody');
    if (body.dataset.fired) return;
    body.dataset.fired = '1';

    const svg  = document.querySelector('.meer-wrap svg');
    const sr   = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const lx   = sr.left + (370/420) * sr.width;
    const ly   = sr.top  + (38/240)  * sr.height;
    const lw   = (44/420) * sr.width;
    const lh   = (32/240) * sr.height;
    body.style.opacity = '0';

    const cx = window.innerWidth  / 2;
    const cy = window.innerHeight / 2;

    // Persistent overlay — hides S5 from the moment of explosion onwards
    let overlay = null;

    const bomb = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
    bomb.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 64 46');
    bomb.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${cx-lw}px;top:${cy-lh}px;width:${lw*2}px;height:${lh*2}px;z-index:500;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;`;
    bomb.innerHTML = `
      <ellipse cx="32" cy="23" rx="28" ry="20" fill="#ffe000"/>
      <ellipse cx="5"  cy="23" rx="5.5" ry="4"  fill="#ffd000" transform="rotate(-18,5,23)"/>
      <ellipse cx="59" cy="23" rx="5.5" ry="4"  fill="#ffd000" transform="rotate(18,59,23)"/>
      <ellipse cx="20" cy="13" rx="9"   ry="5"   fill="#ffff99" opacity=".75" transform="rotate(-22,20,13)"/>
      <ellipse cx="32" cy="23" rx="28" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="#ffb800" stroke-width="1" opacity=".6"/>`;
    document.body.appendChild(bomb);

    // Scale so lemon fills the screen edge-to-edge while staying recognizable
    const targetScale = 1.0 * Math.min(cx / lw, cy / lh);

    // Phase 1: Grow from sun position, centering gradually (6 s)
    const dx = lx - cx, dy = ly - cy;
    bomb.animate([
      { transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) scale(1)`,                              filter:'drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffd700)' },
      { transform:`translate(${dx*.75}px,${dy*.75}px) scale(${targetScale*.06})`,     filter:'drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ffcc00)',  offset:.10 },
      { transform:`translate(${dx*.50}px,${dy*.50}px) scale(${targetScale*.22})`,     filter:'drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ffaa00)', offset:.32 },
      { transform:`translate(${dx*.24}px,${dy*.24}px) scale(${targetScale*.52})`,     filter:'drop-shadow(0 0 44px #ff9900)', offset:.60 },
      { transform:`translate(0,0) scale(${targetScale})`,                              filter:'drop-shadow(0 0 80px #ff7700) brightness(1.2)' },
    ], { duration:6000, easing:'cubic-bezier(.15,0,.6,1)', fill:'forwards' });

    // Phase 2: Suspense — 16 slow pulses (~3.2 s)
    setTimeout(() => {
      let p = 0;
      const pulseIv = setInterval(() => {
        p++;
        bomb.style.filter = p % 2 === 0
          ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 80px #ffee00) brightness(1.5)'
          : 'drop-shadow(0 0 200px #ff7700) brightness(2.8)';
        if (p >= 16) {
          clearInterval(pulseIv);
          // Opaque overlay hides S5 — stays until S6 is settled
          overlay = document.createElement('div');
          overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:#fff9d0;z-index:800;pointer-events:none;opacity:1;';
          document.body.appendChild(overlay);
          bomb.remove();
          lemonSplash(cx, cy);
        }
      }, 200);
    }, 6000);

    // Phase 3: 3 clean explosion flashes → S6  (6000 + 16×200 + 200 = 9400 ms)
    setTimeout(() => {
      [{col:'#ffffff',dur:.7},{col:'#ffdd00',dur:.55,delay:180},{col:'#ffffff',dur:.4,delay:350}].forEach(({col,dur,delay=0}) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          const fl = document.createElement('div');
          fl.style.cssText = `position:fixed;inset:0;background:${col};z-index:999;pointer-events:none;animation:flashBang ${dur}s ease forwards`;
          document.body.appendChild(fl);
          setTimeout(() => fl.remove(), dur*1000+100);
        }, delay);
      });
      buildBoom();
      setTimeout(() => {
        goTo('s6');
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (overlay) {
            overlay.animate([{opacity:1},{opacity:0}],{duration:900,easing:'ease-out',fill:'forwards'});
            setTimeout(() => { if(overlay) overlay.remove(); }, 950);
          }
        }, 300);
      }, 700);
    }, 9400);
  }

  function lemonSplash(cx, cy) {
    const juiceColors = ['#ffe000','#ffd700','#ffcc00','#ffaa00','#ffe566','#f0c800','#ffb800'];

    // 4 shockwave rings
    [{col:'#ffd700',bw:12,dur:900},
     {col:'#ffffff',bw:7, dur:1200,delay:130},
     {col:'#ffaa00',bw:5, dur:1600,delay:290},
     {col:'#fff380',bw:3, dur:2000,delay:480}
    ].forEach(({col,bw,dur,delay=0}) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const r = document.createElement('div');
        r.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px;width:28px;height:28px;border:${bw}px solid ${col};border-radius:50%;z-index:901;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)`;
        document.body.appendChild(r);
        r.animate([
          {transform:'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)', opacity:1},
          {transform:'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(30)', opacity:0}
        ], {duration:dur, easing:'ease-out', fill:'forwards'});
        setTimeout(() => r.remove(), dur+50);
      }, delay);
    });

    // 14 flying juice blobs that vanish mid-air
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 14) * 2 * Math.PI + (Math.random()-.5)*.6;
      const dist  = 100 + Math.random() * 260;
      const sz    = 20 + Math.random() * 36;
      const col   = juiceColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*juiceColors.length)];
      const blob  = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
      blob.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 40 38');
      blob.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px;width:${sz}px;height:${sz*.95}px;z-index:900;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;`;
      blob.innerHTML = `
        <ellipse cx="20" cy="18" rx="17" ry="13" fill="${col}"/>
        <ellipse cx="5"  cy="11" rx="5"  ry="3.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-35,5,11)"/>
        <ellipse cx="33" cy="7"  rx="4.5" ry="3"  fill="${col}" transform="rotate(20,33,7)"/>
        <ellipse cx="35" cy="25" rx="5"  ry="3.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(15,35,25)"/>
        <ellipse cx="8"  cy="28" rx="4"  ry="3"   fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-20,8,28)"/>
        <ellipse cx="16" cy="15" rx="7"  ry="5"   fill="#ffff99" opacity=".5" transform="rotate(-15,16,15)"/>`;
      document.body.appendChild(blob);
      const dur = 700 + Math.random() * 600;
      blob.animate([
        {transform:'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.6)', opacity:1},
        {transform:`translate(calc(-50% + ${Math.cos(angle)*dist}px),calc(-50% + ${Math.sin(angle)*dist}px)) scale(.08) rotate(${300+Math.random()*300}deg)`, opacity:0}
      ], {duration:dur, easing:'cubic-bezier(.1,.6,.3,1)', fill:'forwards'});
      setTimeout(() => blob.remove(), dur+50);
    }

    // 10 juice streams
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const angle  = (i / 10) * 2 * Math.PI;
      const len    = 80 + Math.random() * 130;
      const stream = document.createElement('div');
      stream.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px;width:${len}px;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,rgba(255,200,0,.3),transparent);border-radius:3px;z-index:899;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:translate(0,-50%) rotate(${angle}rad)`;
      document.body.appendChild(stream);
      stream.animate([
        {opacity:1, transform:`translate(0,-50%) rotate(${angle}rad) scaleX(1)`},
        {opacity:0, transform:`translate(0,-50%) rotate(${angle}rad) scaleX(3.5)`}
      ], {duration:700+Math.random()*400, easing:'ease-out', fill:'forwards'});
      setTimeout(() => stream.remove(), 1200);
    }

    // 22 PERSISTENT klodders — fly to random spots and STAY on S6
    const splatShapes = [
      col => `<ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="15" ry="11" fill="${col}"/>
              <ellipse cx="6"  cy="14" rx="5"  ry="3.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-30,6,14)"/>
              <ellipse cx="32" cy="10" rx="4"  ry="3"   fill="${col}" transform="rotate(20,32,10)"/>
              <ellipse cx="34" cy="26" rx="5"  ry="3.5" fill="${col}"/>
              <ellipse cx="8"  cy="28" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-20,8,28)"/>
              <ellipse cx="20" cy="33" rx="3"  ry="4.5" fill="${col}"/>`,
      col => `<path d="M20,20 L22,12 L20,16 L24,8 L21,14 L27,11 L22,16 L30,15 L23,18 L30,21 L23,22 L28,27 L21,23 L24,30 L19,24 L20,32 L18,24 L16,30 L19,23 L14,27 L17,22 L10,21 L17,18 L10,15 L18,16 L13,11 L19,14 L16,8 Z" fill="${col}"/>
              <ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="6" ry="5" fill="${col}" opacity=".35"/>`,
      col => `<ellipse cx="20" cy="18" rx="16" ry="12" fill="${col}"/>
              <ellipse cx="20" cy="30" rx="4"  ry="6"  fill="${col}"/>
              <ellipse cx="9"  cy="10" rx="4.5" ry="3" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(-40,9,10)"/>
              <ellipse cx="32" cy="12" rx="4"  ry="2.5" fill="${col}" transform="rotate(30,32,12)"/>`
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      // Start at explosion center, fly to a random landing spot
      const angle  = Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
      const dist   = 80 + Math.random() * Math.max(cx, cy) * 1.2;
      const landX  = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
      const landY  = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
      const sz     = 35 + Math.random() * 65;
      const col    = juiceColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*juiceColors.length)];
      const shape  = splatShapes[i % splatShapes.length];
      const klodder = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
      klodder.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 40 40');
      klodder.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px;width:${sz}px;height:${sz}px;z-index:902;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;`;
      klodder.innerHTML = shape(col);
      document.body.appendChild(klodder);

      const flyDur  = 400 + Math.random() * 500;  // fast flight
      const tx = landX - cx, ty = landY - cy;
      const stayDur = 5000 + Math.random() * 3000; // stay 5–8 s (well into S6)
      const totalDur = flyDur + stayDur;

      klodder.animate([
        // fly outward
        {transform:'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0.1) rotate(0deg)', opacity:1, offset:0},
        {transform:`translate(calc(-50% + ${tx}px),calc(-50% + ${ty}px)) scale(1.3) rotate(${(Math.random()-.5)*60}deg)`, opacity:1, offset: flyDur/totalDur},
        // splat flat and stay
        {transform:`translate(calc(-50% + ${tx}px),calc(-50% + ${ty}px)) scale(1) rotate(${(Math.random()-.5)*30}deg)`, opacity:.92, offset: (flyDur+200)/totalDur},
        // slow fade at the very end
        {transform:`translate(calc(-50% + ${tx}px),calc(-50% + ${ty}px)) scale(1) rotate(${(Math.random()-.5)*30}deg)`, opacity:.85, offset:.88},
        {transform:`translate(calc(-50% + ${tx}px),calc(-50% + ${ty}px)) scale(1)`, opacity:0}
      ], {duration:totalDur, easing:'ease-out', fill:'forwards'});
      setTimeout(() => klodder.remove(), totalDur+100);
    }
  }

  function buildBoom() {
    const el = document.getElementById('boomWrap'); el.innerHTML = '';
    const colors = ['#c05038','#e07c5c','#d4a030','#6a9e38','#3a7ab0','#9a40b0','#c85070'];
    const text = 'OPEN NU JE ANDERE CADEAUTJE MAAR!';
    let i = 0;
    text.split(' ').forEach(word => {
      const wEl = document.createElement('span'); wEl.className = 'boom-word';
      [...word].forEach(ch => {
        const lEl = document.createElement('span'); lEl.className = 'boom-letter';
        lEl.textContent = ch;
        const ty  = -(12 + Math.random() * 28);
        const r1  = (Math.random() - .5) * 22;
        const r2  = (Math.random() - .5) * 22;
        const dur = (.28 + Math.random() * .45).toFixed(2);
        const ld  = (Math.random() * .35).toFixed(2);
        const sc  = (1.06 + Math.random() * .12).toFixed(2);
        lEl.style.cssText = `--cl:${colors[i%colors.length]};--ty:${ty}px;--r1:${r1}deg;--r2:${r2}deg;--dur:${dur}s;--ld:${ld}s;--sc:${sc}`;
        i++; wEl.appendChild(lEl);
      });
      el.appendChild(wEl);
    });
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
